newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Casino Data EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Casino Data EPS view cut.

text.p: -EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it cuts it earnings per share estimate for Casino Data Systems to a loss of $0.06 for 1997 from a profit of $0.23. For 1998, the firm cut its estimate to a profit of $0.36 a share from a profit of $0.53.

-EVEREN said Casino Data's first quarter $0.18 a share loss reported Tuesday was far below Everen's estimate of a $0.02 a share loss, and that results were hurt by lower gross margins and higher operating expenses. In 1996, Casino reported a first quarter profit of $0.12 a share.
- EVEREN said the company is investing heavily in its new proprietary games division, and its long-term success depends on the success of the division.
- EVEREN said it cut its long-term price target to $6.00 a share from $8.75, based on its new 1998 estimate and a 10 percent discount to the market multiple used in calculating the target.

"We believe that this discount is appropriate given the low confidence in our projections and a lack of credibility in management after the disappointing quarters," EVEREN analyst Steven Bernard said in a statement.
- Shares of Casino Data traded off 1/64 at 4-23/64.
